name: cdk-drag-drop
description: Uses CdkDropList and CdkDrag to let the user reorder a list of items by dragging, moving the item to its new index in the underlying array on drop.
templateCode: {{ task }}
notes: moveItemInArray mutates the array in place and returns void — reassign the array reference afterward (e.g. `this.tasks = [...this.tasks]`) if a component further down the tree relies on OnPush change detection to notice the reorder.

cdkDropListDropped fires even when the item is dropped back at its original index — check `event.previousIndex !== event.currentIndex` before treating the drop as a real reorder if that distinction matters.

Moving items between two different lists (rather than reordering one) requires connecting them with `cdkDropListConnectedTo` and calling `transferArrayItem` instead of `moveItemInArray` in the drop handler.
